field_text_formatted.value: druxt-schema 0.12.2 builds sites that have Canvas installed (#1022). Druxt reads every entity view and form display at build time, and Canvas 1.12.0 answers 500 when JSON:API asks for the second page of them. Druxt now requests them in smaller batches, filtered by entity type and bundle. Canvas 1.13.0 still has the bug, and it's reported against Canvas.
